Omar (Sales): Quick handover from today's MerchantCo demo — they liked the private deployment story but asked for SSO + SCIM timeline. Renewal horizon: 11 months but procurement flagged a budget review in ~6mo -> possible renewal risk. Key context: ~500k ARR, POC includes 2 models, latency is a hard requirement for chat.

Jess (CS): Thanks @Omar — I'll own onboarding. Can we get their SAML cert and sample IdP metadata? Also scheduling a kickoff next Tue 10am PT.

Omar (Sales): Adding notes: they want EU data residency and prefer Dedicated with VPC. Sales has a preliminary pricing range; I will drop details in the account doc.

María (Enablement): I can run a 30-min workshop for their platform engineers covering API keys, routing, and Console observability. Who should invite?

Jess (CS): I'll own the invite and attendee list. @Li please reserve a slot for an eng triage during kickoff — likely to cover network/NAT and cert exchange.

Li (Support Eng): On it. Please paste IdP metadata here when you have it. Note: Dedicated EU provisioning typically takes 5-7 business days depending on capacity.

Omar (Sales): Contact: Ana Lopez <ana@merchantco.com>. Demo notes: positive on latency, asked about rollback/model versioning, wants SLA language. Budget owner: Tom H. (procurement). I'll DM Ana for certs and timeline.

engops-bot: Reminder: Create private deployment request ticket with tag #eu-dedicated. Use runbook: /templates/deploy-private.json

Jess (CS): Action items recap —
1) Sales share IdP metadata + customer contact (Omar)
2) CS schedule kickoff + invite (Jess)
3) Eng create infra ticket & estimate provisioning ETA (Li)
4) Enablement prep workshop + materials (María)
5) Sales upload pricing and procurement info to account doc (Omar)
I'll track these in the account tracker and ping owners for updates.

Omar (Sales): I'll update the account doc now and DM Ana for certs. cc @Jess

Li (Support Eng): Created ticket INF-4821, note: provisioning ETA ~6 business days if EU nodes required. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-4821

Jess (CS): Thanks — I'll send the kickoff invite and attach the onboarding checklist and a short eval prompt set to monitor model quality during rollout.

María (Enablement): Draft deck uploaded to #cs-resources, will tailor slides to MerchantCo infra questions.

Omar (Sales): Anything else we should flag now? :thumbsup:

Jess (CS): Nothing else from CS. Will follow up after kickoff with owners, timeline, and next steps. :white_check_mark:

Li (Support Eng): Ping me if the SAML cert format is nonstandard or if they require custom network routing.
